harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s upload endpoint on TCP/8080. It atomically publishes unique receipts for bodies up to 65,536 bytes, returns 413 for larger bodies, cleans up interrupted uploads, and returns 404 for other paths. The legacy receipt remains unchanged. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 were retained.
actions_performed: Installed a Python 3 standard-library upload service on node1.
Enabled persistent systemd startup and opened TCP/8080 in firewalld.
Tested upload sizes 0, 1, 65,535, 65,536, and 65,537 bytes from node2.
Verified accepted payloads against server receipts using SHA-256.
Simulated an interrupted request and verified no receipt or temporary file remained.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified boot-ID changes and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Accept raw bodies through 65536 bytes and reject larger bodies with HTTP 413 before publishing
evidence.summary: Sizes through 65,536 returned 200; 65,537 returned 413. Only the four accepted test bodies produced receipts.

evidence.requirement: Publish each accepted upload as a separate file with identical bytes
evidence.summary: Four uniquely named receipts have sizes and SHA-256 hashes exactly matching the four accepted client payloads.

evidence.requirement: Interrupted requests leave no completed receipt
evidence.summary: Node2 closed after sending 1,241 of 10,000 declared bytes; node1 retained the same receipt count and had zero temporary files.
GET and POST requests to /other returned 404, including after both restarts.
received/prior.bin remains 28 bytes with original metadata and SHA-256 ac9690aa0a0fe733a2702464777a0148b5a189d0a2f6eef1993268ebc70665fe.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 after repair and restarts.
Healthy baseline boot ID f1afbc7f-…; safe reboot acknowledged; recovered with boot ID 0d513cc4-…. Service, listener, firewall, stored receipts, and a fresh byte-identical upload all recovered.

Healthy client baseline boot ID bf4e9cbb-…; safe reboot acknowledged; recovered with boot ID a5ed88d9-…. Networking and curl recovered, a fresh upload returned 200, and node1 stored its matching receipt.
